channel.title: Web3 Hub
channel.description: Web3 Hub reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: Aviva, Ripple tokenize £22 billion sterling fund on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple launched a tokenized share class of Aviva’s £22 billion sterling fund on the XRP Ledger, adding on-chain access to its money market fund.

item.title: Aviva puts £22bn sterling fund share class on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple launched a tokenized share class of the £22 billion Sterling Liquidity Fund on XRPL, with £50 million invested by Aviva at launch.

item.title: Solana’s Alpenglow upgrade targets 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, targeting finality in 150 milliseconds; users keep their wallets and fees as payments and exchange deposits can settle sooner.

item.title: Tether wins 15 commitments for Bitcoin mining toolkit
item.description: Tether says 15 Bitcoin mining operators, equipment makers and pools will build integrations for its open-source MDK, which aims to connect software across systems.

item.title: Tether says 15 firms will build Bitcoin mining integrations
item.description: Tether says 15 mining operators, hardware makers and pools will build integrations for its open kit, aiming to let software work across mining systems.

item.title: OCC lets crypto platforms offer stablecoin rewards
item.description: The OCC's final GENIUS Act rule leaves crypto platforms able to offer rewards on stablecoin balances, while barring issuers from paying holders interest.

item.title: Ethereum postpones Glamsterdam’s Hoodi test over contract risk
item.description: Ethereum postponed Glamsterdam’s Oct. 26 Hoodi test to investigate EIP-8037’s effects on deployed contracts; no replacement date or mainnet schedule is set.

item.title: OCC leaves crypto exchange stablecoin rewards in place
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying holders directly but leaves exchanges room to offer rewards, taking effect Jan. 18, 2027.

item.title: zerofi bridge routes start with the asset you need
item.description: ZeroFi connects Monero XMR with Ethereum’s zXMR token; compare the source, destination, fees, confirmation wait and redemption path before signing.

item.title: Solana swap slippage: how much should you allow?
item.description: Set slippage to cover a realistic price move, not to force a trade through: the right tolerance depends on liquidity, volatility and the amount you swap.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, targeting 150-millisecond finality; wallets need no changes, while validators and data services face protocol shifts.

item.title: Three checks to make before a bridge transfer is complete
item.description: A source-chain transaction marked successful does not prove a bridge transfer is complete; check the network, transaction details and destination status before acting.

item.title: OCC leaves crypto exchanges room to offer stablecoin rewards
item.description: The OCC's GENIUS Act rule bars issuers from paying stablecoin interest but leaves exchanges room to offer rewards, subject to case-by-case review.

item.title: Why Polygon PoS withdrawals take two steps
item.description: Polygon PoS withdrawals split the burn and Ethereum release so validators can checkpoint the Polygon block and the bridge can verify a proof before paying out.

item.title: How a tron swap works from your own wallet
item.description: A wallet-based tron swap sends tokens through a smart contract, with the wallet signing each transaction and paying any required network fees.

item.title: Visa and Mesh link crypto wallets to 175 million merchants
item.description: Visa and Mesh will let wallet users pay online and in stores from crypto or stablecoin balances across 175 million Visa merchant locations, without a separate card.

item.title: Byreal in 6 Steps: Swap, Add Liquidity and Trade Markets
item.description: Byreal’s six-step flow covers wallet setup, token swaps, concentrated liquidity and market selection, with checks on quotes, price ranges and trading risk.

item.title: JPMorgan Brings JPM Coin to Ethereum for Institutions
item.description: JPMorgan put its dollar deposit token on Ethereum on Oct. 19, adding a public network for institutional clients to move wholesale money on-chain.

item.title: Fermi Swap: When to Call Directly and When to Aggregate
item.description: Fermi Swap trades draw from a market maker’s token inventory; direct calls are simple, while aggregators can compare routes when they support the venue.

item.title: QuickSwap Slippage: Set a Limit Without Overpaying
item.description: QuickSwap slippage tolerance sets the minimum output for a swap; learn how to choose a limit that can clear without accepting needless price movement.
